description: This source file defines a service class 'NotesWidgetService' that extends Android's RemoteViewsService. It overrides the onGetViewFactory method to provide a factory for creating RemoteViews for a widget, specifically returning an instance of 'NotesWidgetViewsFactory'.

classes.name: NotesWidgetService
classes.description: A service that provides RemoteViewsFactory for a Notes widget, enabling it to display dynamic content.

methods.name: onGetViewFactory
methods.description: Overrides the method to return a new instance of NotesWidgetViewsFactory, which supplies the views for the widget.
